product.shippingText: Every bag is made to order and ships worldwide from Ukraine in [X] working days. Import duties for US orders are included at checkout.
product.careText: Light scratches rub out with a fingertip, and the leather darkens with wear. If the bag gets wet, let it dry at room temperature away from heaters.

dims.laptop: Fits a {n} inch laptop placed upright

personal.title:
Your initials,
pressed into the leather
personal.lead: A gift for a wedding, a colleague or yourself. Add up to three letters when you order, and we emboss them by hand before the bag leaves the workshop.
personal.alt: Front pocket of a cognac Crazy Horse leather bag with your initials embossed

leather.title: Crazy Horse leather gets better every year
leather.lead: Oiled and waxed full grain. Light marks rub out with a fingertip, and the colour deepens the longer you carry it.

hardware.title: Silver, brass or gold hardware
hardware.text: Rivets set by hand where the handle takes the weight.
hardware.alt: Three leather handles riveted to a cognac tote, with silver, brass and gold rivets

pockets.title: Pockets inside
pockets.text: Slip pockets stitched inside the bag.
pockets.alt: Inside a cognac leather bag: stitched slip pockets along the side

patina.title: Ages with you
patina.text: Scuffs fade into a darker patina.
patina.alt: Flap of a cognac Crazy Horse leather crossbody with natural pull-up marks

story.title: Started by a husband and wife, still a family workshop
story.text: Old Town Leather is a family workshop in Vinnytsia, in the centre of Ukraine. A husband and wife started it, and today a small team cuts, stitches and finishes every bag by hand. Many of our customers have become friends we still write to.
story.alt: The husband and wife who founded Old Town Leather, standing on a tree lined street

footer.tagline: Handmade leather bags from a family workshop in Ukraine.
